slides.title: Multilevel Inheritance

slides.title: Virtual Base Class Keyword

slides.title: Constructor Execution Order
slides.prompt: In what order are constructors executed during derived object creation?
options: Base class constructor first, then derived class constructor
Derived class constructor first, then base class constructor
slides.correctAnswer: Base class constructor first, then derived class constructor

slides.title: Final Class Specifier
slides.prompt: Fill in specifier that prevents further inheritance of a class.

slides.title: Private Inheritance Behavior
slides.prompt: Under private inheritance, public members of base class become what in derived class?

slides.title: Base Class Constructor Invocation
slides.prompt: Fill in symbol used in derived constructor to call base constructor.

slides.title: Destructor Execution Order in Inheritance
slides.prompt: In what order are destructors called when a derived object is destroyed?
options: Derived class destructor first, then base class destructor
Base class destructor first, then derived class destructor
slides.correctAnswer: Derived class destructor first, then base class destructor

slides.title: Protected Access Specifier
slides.prompt: Fill in specifier that keeps members hidden from outside but accessible to derived classes.
